title: Glance M0 Gold / TrainingRecord case
description: One owner-labeled mail case for M0 gold and later TrainingRecord export. Consent defaults false; redacted body preferred over raw.

id.description: Stable case id, e.g. gold-YYYYMMDD-001 or imported rm-001.

source.description: Mail surface the message was read from (test inbox).

subject.description: Subject line; redact PII the same way as body.

redactedBody.description: Full body after privacyShield / mask-ids ([NAME], [ORG], [EMAIL], [PHONE], [DATE], [IMAGE]). Prefer this for labeling sessions.

bodyHash.description: sha256 of canonical redacted body when full body is not stored.

excerpt.description: Short redacted excerpt sufficient to re-identify the judgment call.

ownerLabel.description: Owner judgment for M0: ASK = open loop / Do It card may be correct; SILENT = no card. PROMISE/HOLD/CLOSE from the older intent pipeline map into notes or expectedAction, not this enum.

expectedAction.description: If ASK: name the true-close outcome (close fabric) or the single next step toward it (e.g. 'issue+verify invoice', 'pay after approval', 'obtain file from third party then attach'). Not a draft-helper end state — draft/file/calendar are intermediate. null when SILENT.

wrongDoIt.description: true if surfacing a Do It card on this message would be incorrect or harmful. Must be true whenever a Do It would violate silence-beats-wrong-Do-It.

notes.description: Free-text rationale, edge cases, HE/EN nuance, link to thread.

labeledAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the owner (or CoS under owner direction) labeled.

consent.description: Explicit training consent for this record. Product default is off; gold labeling on the test inbox may set true only when Sali opts in for that batch.

modelLabelPrior.description: Prior model-assigned label if imported; never treat as ownerLabel.

ownerVerified.description: True only when labeledBy is sali. The ingest refuses to set true for any other labeledBy.

actionLabel.description: Canonical family|step the label accepts. The model's action on a take-model mark, the engine's action on a take-engine mark, or an explicit actionLabel when the close is neither. null when SILENT. expectedAction is the plain name of what that action closes.
